pr_title: [prototype] sql: enable secondary tenants to write zone configurations
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/67323)

As discussed offline, there's a couple things we still want to change here. Namely, we want to switch from a long running migration to a startup migration here -- that seems more suited to this on second thought. This is also missing a default zone config for the system database. I'm merging this for now but I'll come back with a separate PR with these changes considering it's a prototype branch.

issue_context.title: sql: move `system.zones` into the tenant keyspace
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

Part of #66348. We need to ad`system.zones` for each tenant, and massage the existing zone config generation code to work off of descriptor IDs (instead of SystemTenantObjectIDs that it does today).
comments:
> into the tenant keyspace and massage the existing zone config generation code to work on descriptor IDs (instead of system tenant object IDs as it does today).

I feel like this is a bit misleading. Is there really anything to be done? What is an `object ID` if not just a `descriptor ID` (plus some fake placeholder IDs)? What makes anything `system tenant`?

> Is there really anything to be done? What is an object ID if not just a descriptor ID (plus some fake placeholder IDs)? What makes anything system tenant?

I was hoping to get rid of the concept of: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/15ee387449e5c9405f284c6c423a19dee0fc5d00/pkg/config/system.go#L42 once `system.zones` moves into the tenant keyspace. It's merely a wrapper around descriptor IDs, so there isn't much here other than cleaning up all places that convert descriptor IDs to this type.

review_comments: We need to remove these `if [..]Codec.ForSystemTenant()` checks below, for `RemoveIndexZoneConfigs`. I think we'd benefit from a general audit of all these cases. Maybe lets just try and port over the system tenant zone config logic tests to the tenants right now, almost all of them should apply (save for the distinguished ranges, and for replication reports). That should shake out all these tests.
Elsewhere in this file, DecodeKeyIntoZoneIDAndSuffix should thread in a codec.
This function should also thread in a codec. Does it have to return this SystemTenantObjectID type?
Better yet, can we get rid of the SystemTenantObjectID type entirely? Instead we could ensure we're using a codec + descpb.ID everywhere, specifying the SystemSQLCodec explicitly whenever needed.
Why? We have the codec available to us: `p.ExecCfg().Codec`.
Shouldn't it "just work" if we got rid of the `if !p.ExecCfg().Codec.ForSystemTenant()` check above?
If we remove the `if !p.ExecCfg().Codec.ForSystemTenant() {` check in `ShowZoneConfig`, we should "just" get introspection.
This _function_ (as opposed to a method on the `SystemConfig` type) should thread in a codec.
